people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
translations.bsb: but will go to my country and my kindred to take a wife for my son Isaac.”
translations.kjv: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
translations.asv: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son Isaac.
